source: MassGIS Hydrography (1:25,000) water polygons for Boston and its harbour, as shipped in map/water.json of the FareSight Map Redesign export (sha256 c2c47d2c9b50d3aa01f9b45c3c4a4234be450f71caa8256396711b40f331828c). Coordinates are sculpture units x 100000 (x east, z south; shared/src/projection.ts). Each polygon is {c, r}: c is the MassGIS POLY_CODE (6 fresh water, 7 tidal flats, 8 salt water) and r its rings as [x0, z0, x1, z1, ...], the first the shore and the rest islands.
